snippet.title: Neon Knives - Steam Couch Co-Op Fest Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Two of you do not belong. Neon Knives is an award-winning couch multiplayer game of stealth and deception. Blend into the crowd, hunt down your opponent, and take them out—all while being hunted yourself. Trust no one.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317170/Neon_Knives/

Itch: https://cookiecrayon.itch.io/neon-knives
